customSections.label: Start Dates by Grade
customSections.content: SPPS begins the year in two stages. Grades 1–12 start September 8; Pre-K and kindergarten use September 8–9 for Welcome Meetings and begin classes September 10. ECSE follows the Pre-K schedule.

customSections.label: October 30 and March 26 Are No-School Days for PreK–5 Only
customSections.content: SPPS marks these two dates green rather than blue. PreK–5 students do not attend. Grades 6–12 remain in session, including grades 6–8 at PreK–8 schools.

customSections.label: Grading Periods
customSections.content: SPPS uses four quarters. Quarter 1 and Quarter 3 end on regular school days. Quarter 2 ends January 29, which is also a no-school day for all students. Quarter start dates below are based on the next scheduled student day after the preceding quarter ends; the SPPS PDF explicitly lists the quarter-end dates.

customSections.label: Why SPPS Shows Two Juneteenth Dates
customSections.content: The current English PDF lists Friday, June 18, 2027, as Juneteenth observed, with district offices closed. The SPPS calendar page also lists June 19 as Juneteenth. The last day of school is June 11, so neither date affects student attendance.

customSections.label: How to Read the SPPS Calendar Colors
customSections.content: Check the color before treating an SPPS date as a districtwide closure. Green dates apply only to PreK–5; grades 6–12 are still in school.

customSections.content: The one-page family calendar covers the main attendance schedule. Families in specialized settings should confirm program instructions, and all families should use the district or school calendar for bell times, activities, detailed conferences, and schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: When does SPPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1-12 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Pre-K and kindergarten hold Welcome Meetings September 8-9 and start Thursday, September 10. ECSE follows the Pre-K calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS MEA break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: SPPS students in all grades have no school October 15-16, 2026, for the state teacher meeting commonly called MEA.

calendarFaqs.q: Do SPPS secondary students have October 30 off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 30 is a PreK-5-only conference-preparation closure. Grades 6-12 remain in session, including grades 6-8 at PreK-8 schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS Winter Break in 2026-27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Wednesday, December 23, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SPPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 5, through Friday, April 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of SPPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for PreK-12 and the end of Quarter 4 are Friday, June 11, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does SPPS show both June 18 and June 19 for Juneteenth?
calendarFaqs.a: The current English PDF lists June 18, 2027, as Juneteenth observed, with district offices closed. The SPPS calendar page also lists June 19 as Juneteenth. The student year ends June 11, so neither date changes student attendance.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the SPPS 2026-27 calendar available in other languages?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. SPPS publishes official Hmong, Karen, Somali, and Spanish editions in addition to English.

sourceReviewDetails: The grade-specific opening schedule, districtwide no-school dates, PreK–5-only closures, quarter endings, breaks, holidays, and last day were checked against the official English calendar.
The PDF color key was reviewed because green dates apply only to PreK–5 while grades 6–12 remain in session.
Official Hmong, Karen, Somali, and Spanish PDFs are linked separately as translations of the family calendar.
The current official calendar page lists June 18 as Juneteenth observed and June 19 as Juneteenth; the English PDF prints only the June 18 observed office closure. The student year ends June 11.
The MySchoolDates .ics file is a one-time import and does not sync with later SPPS revisions.
